Research_Theme: Surface discharge and solute flux; Stream water quality parameters
Description: As of June 2024, the location ER-PHF1 was merged with this location (ER-PHF0). The ER-PHF1 location historically represented winter time sampling taken by hand. Data used to quantify integrated watershed processes. Discharge calculations based on a rating cuve approach. Two ISCOs serve the site. One to collect anions, cations, trace metals, DIC and NOPC. The second collects samples for stable isotopes with each bottle filled with approx. 2 cm oil to minimize evaporation between sample retrival. ISCOs collect from the stream during ice-free days (April through October) and sample from winter storage (WS) November through March. One multi-paramter probe serve this site, measuring water quality at 5-minute intervals.
